status: All commercial probabilities, labor hours, prices, demand and cost allocations are explicit analyst hypotheses, not measured customer behavior or actual invoices. Public plant table values are source facts; arithmetic is executed. No customer contacts, purchases or payments.
price_policy: Maximize weighted expected complete 26-week profit over declared prices; same scope, quality and responsibility at every price. Fixed development weights are risk-neutral planning preferences, not empirical frequencies. Capacity and first-job funding are screened before ranking. STOP is allowed for a nonpositive maximum.

human_comparator.scope: same 1-case source/cost reconciliation, evidence gap register, executable decision instrument, sampling plan specification, independent checking, packaging and one correction round
human_comparator.basis: transparent professional labor estimate; not an observed invoice or willingness to pay

common_shock.scope: one shared state per whole campaign; conditional Bernoulli outcomes remain independent given this state, so unconditional jobs share demand, cost and quality exposure

retention.decision: Feasible funds first, then maximum positive expected incremental benefit. Expected uses only during remaining 26-week horizon, capacity reduced during build, success and scope fit uncertain. Ordinary library with same asset has identical economics: no graph premium. Costs and savings are unmeasured hypotheses.
retention.gate: Only after a completed paid acceptance, when customer field-experiment net EVSI is positive in declared central illustration; fictional buyer adoption is not real readiness. Protected original seed and operating/fixed/contract reserves remain intact.

plant.source: Simonic 2021 public Table 5, transcribed and independently checked in the primary study
plant.scope: Partial-table pre-tax scenario. Missing destination specification, long-run uptime, salts and complete process costs prevent an actual plant investment recommendation.

information_experiment.scope: Optional future empirical sampling/pilot experiment only. These prior/likelihood ranges are analyst stress bounds, not calibrated probabilities. M1 Gate Pack does not supply this signal. Customer finances this experiment separately; provider module surplus does not finance EUR180000 plant.

effort_accounting.labor_hours: Unmeasured future customer-specific integration/configuration/handoff paid-effort allowance only; not observed time, not mandatory manual scientific review, and not required by the supported automated pack. Excludes separately costed acquisition, packaging, corrections and support. Zero residual effort is evaluated explicitly.
effort_accounting.startup: USD2400 is hypothetical repeatable commercial service setup, not measured manuscript authoring cost. Complete actual research cost remains unknown.
effort_accounting.cost_classes: A: all paid-delivery base, corrections, failed attempts, packaging, support, model allowances, infrastructure, lead acquisition, payment fees, receivable loss and overhead. Optional B: incremental module construction and maintenance only; no second charge for learning during delivery.
